$comment: Every word a visitor reads. Edit, then rebuild. 'start' and 'end' drive the countdown and both calendar links (keep the UTC offset: -06:00 is Dallas in December). Empty URLs hide their links: set rsvpUrl and an RSVP button appears on the Attend channel and in the top bar. While 'artist' is "0.0.0" (her placeholder) the poster credit is left off. 'work.projects' is a list of { title, by, url }; it shows on The work once it has entries.
title: C3 Showcase

about: The Creative Computing class puts a semester of work on show: games, apps, music and interactive art. Come and play with it.
